tagline: Build it. Prove it. Ship it.
positioning: Proof over promises. Local-first software with receipts, honest claims, and user-owned workflows.

availabilityTaxonomy.derivation: Availability is about the product, not its newest build lane: a product is AVAILABLE when release.publicVersion names a current public release, even while a newer candidate is also in flight. WITHDRAWN means the former public release was withdrawn and no current public download exists. NO_PUBLIC_RELEASE means no public release of the product exists yet.

products.releaseNote: Lights Out v11.1.3 is the current public Windows release, published 2026-09-15 from release source commit 5f8ede7. The shipped artifacts — the Windows installer EXE and the portable ZIP — were qualified by three consecutive Reality Gate runs on that exact source identity (receipts 342c11bc-d2d6-4918-8920-a495211ff69b and 6323d762-859a-4385-91d7-923cd1bc1610, plus pre-publication run adff2359-3350-4d6d-9e04-74c295003c58; all PASSED, receipt-verified), then hash-verified after upload. Public downloads are served from the Proof Foundry mirror alongside a published SHA256SUMS.txt; a GitHub release record exists but anonymous access is blocked. These are unsigned Windows builds — not Authenticode-signed. The earlier RC4-candidate qualification (receipt 6b67a712-33ba-4cd6-9c4a-81e66f056750, artifact SHA-256 c7872350...) covered superseded candidate bytes and is retained only as historical evidence.

products.name: GhostLayer
products.summary: A controllable RAM-backed layer between active work and permanent storage. Stage files in RAM, open them for editing, recover from interruptions, commit safely with multi-select batch workflow and keyboard shortcuts — no cloud, no account, no telemetry.
products.cardSummary: Stage files in RAM, recover interrupted work, then commit selected changes on your terms.

presentation.valueLine: Keep files in a temporary RAM layer. Review changes and choose what to commit to disk.
presentation.cardImageAlt: GhostLayer staging list showing two files in RAM with commit and discard controls.

limits: Unsigned by Windows — not Microsoft publisher signed, not SmartScreen trusted.
Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch; choose More info, then Run anyway.
Checksum is not a code signature.
Custody receipt does not constitute malware certification or Microsoft signing.
products.releaseNote: Public release v0.4.0 (Windows). Unsigned by Windows — not Microsoft publisher signed, not SmartScreen trusted. The release was verified with 188/188 tests passing, a clean build, and packaged runtime qualification (13/13 steps). v0.4.0 adds multi-select batch workflow (select, Commit Selected, Discard Selected), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+A, Escape, Shift-click range), tray status tooltips (staged/modified/conflict counts), and safer commit routing that prevents renderer-supplied destination redirection. The tray Discard All bypass has been removed. Verify the SHA-256 before running. Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch — choose More info, then Run anyway.

limits: Users upgrading from ForgeCast v0.3.3 or earlier must uninstall the old app before installing v0.3.5: the signing identity changed at v0.3.4, and v0.3.5 does not restore in-place compatibility with those builds.
Users upgrading from v0.3.4 can install v0.3.5 normally: same signing identity, settings and data carry over (verified by an on-device upgrade test).
Because ForgeCast is local-first, uninstalling the old app removes app-local settings and other locally stored data unless separately preserved.
Checksum is not a code signature.
GitHub release assets may be unavailable to anonymous visitors due to an account-level restriction; Proof Foundry distribution is the authoritative public download path.

products.releaseNote: Public release v0.3.5 (Android APK). Adds Ask ForgeCast (deterministic weather-decision answers with evidence, no cloud chatbot), condition- and timing-aware Wear/Bring clothing guidance, dynamic decision widgets (Best Window, Wear/Bring, rain and cooling changes ahead, honest stale state), a forecast-aware Ask discovery strip with screen-reader support, and Samsung OneUI widget reliability (native cached-bitmap restore after reboot or background freezing). Upgrading from v0.3.4 keeps settings and data (verified on device); upgrading from v0.3.3 or earlier requires uninstall/reinstall. Served via Proof Foundry distribution; the same bytes are attached to the v0.3.5 GitHub release.

products.name: ProofShot
products.summary: Local-first Windows proof workstation: capture what matters online, keep a proof bundle with SHA-256 receipts and a Proof Passport, and verify it later without trusting the tool or the internet. Public release v2.0.0 — the hardened HyperSnatch rebrand.
products.cardSummary: Local proof workstation for web context, SHA-256 bundles, and offline verification. v2.0.0 public release for Windows.

presentation.valueLine: Capture a page's real resources into a sealed proof bundle you can verify offline, years later.
presentation.cardImageAlt: ProofShot production brand artwork — the aperture mark over a dark carbon-and-vermilion field.

limits: The Windows installer is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen will prompt on first launch. Verify the SHA-256 before running.
Capture is structural, not photographic — SmartDecode records the page's own resources and structure; there is no pixel-screenshot capture engine.
ProofForge is a separate project and is not this product.
products.build: Electron desktop application: SmartDecode extraction pipeline, proof-bundle export (SHA-256 manifests, Proof Passport, offline HTML verifier). Public release v2.0.0 — the hardened ProofShot rebrand of the qualified HyperSnatch engine, with deterministic app.asar, Electron fuses enforced, and Reality Gate source→build→artifact custody.
products.releaseNote: Public release v2.0.0 (Windows). Unsigned installer — Windows SmartScreen will prompt; verify the SHA-256 first (More info → Run anyway). Custody: source 6e7fc6bf, deterministic asar, fuses enforced, independent adversarial gate green. Migrates existing HyperSnatch profiles non-destructively on first launch.
